_comment: The one output shape every Loom reviewer and assurance agent emits (2.1.0, hardening plan row 5.1). Until now agent output was a line format a human retyped into a decision; a register-less run still produced a verdict, findings carried no confidence and no citation field anyone checked, and the reviewer agents sat outside the method's own model-risk rules. This schema is what scripts/agent-output-check.mjs validates fixtures and agent definitions against. The human-readable lines stay — a person reads them — and the JSON block follows them, so a downstream consumer (the Kosli seam, the operations-signal log, an examiner's query) reads one shape. It is deliberately small: a schema an agent can hold in its prompt.

prompt_version._comment: the agent definition's version — the prompt_version pinned for this role in docs/governance/model-manifest.json

model._comment: the model_id pinned for this role in docs/governance/model-manifest.json; 'unknown' is a finding, not a value

inputs_read._comment: every file or command the verdict rests on, repo-relative

register_state._comment: whether the register this agent judges against (data-risk register, obligations, model manifest, knowledge pins) was present. absent ⇒ verdict MUST be INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

confidence._comment: how far the evidence read supports the verdict — low when the judgement leaned on prose rather than a record

id._comment: the agent's own numbering (FAIL 3, WATCH 2, ASSESS 1) or a rule id

subject._comment: what the finding is about: a DR-*/CTRL-*/OB-* id, a file:section, a model role, a package@version

evidence_refs._comment: at least one: the record the finding rests on. A finding with no evidence is an opinion and does not go in this array

route._comment: the operations-signal vocabulary, where the agent routes (change-watch, risk-reviewer)

reason._comment: REQUIRED when verdict is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: what was missing and what would make the judgement possible

invariants: register_state == 'absent' ⇒ verdict == 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE' and reason is present
verdict == 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE' ⇒ findings may name what is missing but carry no PASS-implying claim
verdict in {PASS, CONFORMANT, ACCEPTABLE, CLEAR} ⇒ no finding of severity critical or high
